question: What carriers do we work with?
agent_answer:
We work with 3 carriers (from TMS):

| Carrier | Type | Cost/kg | Avg Transit |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Kerry Express** (CAR-001) | Ground | ฿15/kg | 2 days |
| **SCG Cold Chain** (CAR-002) | Refrigerated | ฿25/kg | 1 day |
| **Flash Express Premium** (CAR-003) | Refrigerated | ฿35/kg | 1 day |

Note: SCG Cold Chain and Flash Express Premium are both cold chain carriers — required for any refrigerated products. Kerry Express (ground) is for ambient/processed goods only.
